description: This file defines a Blazor component class called BlazorComponent which extends ComponentBase. It manages refresh requests via a singleton RefreshBroadcast instance, subscribing to refresh events and providing methods to trigger state updates.

classes.name: BlazorComponent
classes.description: A base component providing refresh functionality via the RefreshBroadcast singleton.

methods.name: OnInitialized
methods.description: Overrides the base method to subscribe to the refresh event upon initialization.

methods.name: CallRequestRefresh
methods.description: Method to request a refresh, invoking the broadcast's refresh request method.

methods.name: DoRefresh
methods.description: Event handler invoked when a refresh is requested; it calls StateHasChanged to re-render the component.
